source.title: A Small Upgrade
source.description:
Greetings my esteemed <class> acquaintance! My name is John Trinketman, world renown traveler and puzzle solver! Never heard of me, have you? No matter! I am here in Ironforge looking for two of the most prestigious pieces of jewelry this side of Azeroth has ever seen! It is said they form a puzzle!

Unfortunately, rumor has it that they both reside in the dangerous Blackrock Mountain! Surely an adventurer of your caliber would have no issue finding these pieces for me?
